neighbours.label: nouns for an exemplar worth copying: 'model' (a model of / for), 'best practice', shared experiences as lessons, in the sense of a standard others should follow
fire: The village is now seen as a model for other towns trying to cut waste.
Inspectors described the hospital's hygiene rules as best practice.
Her small school has become a national model of inclusive teaching.
The charity wants to spread best practice among rural clinics.
Denmark is often held up as a model of how cycling can work in cities.
The report lists ten examples of best practice in flood planning.
Supporters hope the project will serve as a model for the region.
The new guidelines draw on best practice from schools abroad.
quiet: The village is now home to a model railway that runs along the river.
Inspectors described the hospital's new car park as far too small.
Her small school has bought a plastic model of the human skeleton.
The charity wants to buy more ambulances for rural clinics.
Denmark is often held up as a place where people cycle in the rain.
The report lists ten new model numbers for the company's printers.
Supporters hope the project will finish before the end of the year.
The new guidelines draw on football practice sessions from abroad.

notes: Card: ' model', ' best practice', ' experi(encias)' in policy and development text; logit promotes ' example'. Probes: 'a model of how' 0.80, 'best practice' 0.64; fashion model and car model near zero.
